summary: Turn photos of an item into a real, LIVE eBay listing — identifies the item, researches sold-comp pricing, assesses condition, fills the essential listing fields, then drives your logged-in Chrome to eBay, fills the Create-listing form (photos included), and PUBLISHES it. Triggers on `/sell`, or messages like "sell this on ebay", "list this on ebay", "make me an ebay listing", "what's this worth + list it" — especially when photos are attached. On "List it" eBay validates and the script fills any required field from the payload and retries; if it still can't satisfy a required field it falls back to saving a DRAFT (never publishes junk) and reports what's missing.
